blocks.unit: do not buy a separate TrainingPeaks subscription
blocks.context: Connect the TrainingPeaks account you use for training. I apply Premium through the coaching relationship after the connection is in place.

blocks.title: Set Up One Account
blocks.description: Five minutes now can prevent weeks of split data.

steps.action: Connect your athlete account to me.
steps.detail: Use the private coaching-account invitation in your welcome email.
Do not purchase Premium yourself. Message me if it has not appeared after I accept the connection.
Garmin, Wahoo, COROS, Zwift, or another service should send completed files into the same athlete account.
Check that duration, power or heart rate when available, and your comment all appear on the completed workout.
Duplicate TrainingPeaks accounts split your history. Ask me before merging or reconnecting anything if you are unsure which account to use.

blocks.content: I check the coach connection, Premium status, and one uploaded activity before I call your setup finished.

blocks.question: TrainingPeaks shows your plan, but completed rides are landing in a second account. What should you do?

options.text: Keep both accounts and summarize the other one in comments
Stop and ask Matti which account to use before changing integrations

blocks.explanation: Your plan and completed files need to live in the same account. Ask before merging accounts or reconnecting a device.
